items.name: analog-foundation
items.title: Analog Foundation
items.description: The shared token layer, lighting variables, and surface palettes required by Analog UI controls.
items.docs: Install this foundation item with Analog UI controls to add shared analog tokens and the tactile component recipes used by the registry controls.

.analog-surface-recess.box-shadow:
inset calc(sin(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * var(--recess-depth))
        calc(cos(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * calc(-1 * var(--recess-depth)))
        calc(var(--recess-depth) * 2) rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.95 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset calc(sin(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * var(--recess-depth-inner))
        calc(cos(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * calc(-1 * var(--recess-depth-inner)))
        calc(var(--recess-depth-inner) * 6) rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      calc(sin(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * 1px)
        calc(cos(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * -1px) 0
        rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.15 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.analog-surface-recess-sm.box-shadow:
inset calc(sin(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * var(--recess-depth))
        calc(cos(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * calc(-1 * var(--recess-depth)))
        calc(var(--recess-depth) * 2) rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset calc(sin(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * var(--recess-depth-inner))
        calc(cos(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * calc(-1 * var(--recess-depth-inner)))
        calc(var(--recess-depth-inner) * 6) rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      calc(sin(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * 1px)
        calc(cos(var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg)) * -1px) 0
        rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.15 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.analog-track-slot.background:
linear-gradient(
        var(--analog-light-angle-track, 180deg),
        rgba(
            255,
            255,
            255,
            calc(var(--analog-track-slot-gradient-highlight-alpha) * var(--analog-light-power, 1))
          )
          0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 34%,
        rgba(
            0,
            0,
            0,
            calc(var(--analog-track-slot-gradient-shadow-alpha) * var(--analog-light-power, 1))
          )
          100%
      ),
      var(--analog-track-slot-base)

.analog-track-slot-guide.box-shadow:
0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.04 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      0 0 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.35 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.analog-wheel-lighting.background:
linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 0%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, #000 100%),
      linear-gradient(
        var(--analog-light-angle-wheel-face, 180deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.12 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.05 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))) 20%,
        transparent 48%,
        transparent 62%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.72 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))) 100%
      )

.surface-button.--foil:
repeating-conic-gradient(
        from calc(var(--analog-light-angle-surface, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 0deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 7deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22) 13deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 19deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 26deg
      ),
      repeating-radial-gradient(
        circle at 50% 50%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) 0,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 1px,
        transparent 2px,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 3px,
        transparent 5px
      )
.surface-button.box-shadow:
0 0 0 1px inset rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      0 8px 16px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.2 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.surface-button.variant-black.box-shadow:
0 0 0 1px inset rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      0 8px 16px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.8 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.6 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.surface-button.analog-dial-surface.--foil:
url('./texture.webp'),
      linear-gradient(
        calc(var(--analog-light-angle-surface, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 24%,
        transparent 48%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 100%
      ),
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        calc(var(--analog-light-angle-surface, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 0,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 1px,
        transparent 1px,
        transparent 6px
      )

.surface-button.analog-screw-surface.--foil:
url('./texture.webp'),
      linear-gradient(
        calc(var(--analog-light-angle-surface, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 24%,
        transparent 48%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 100%
      )

.surface-button::after.box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 0 0 calc(var(--spacing-track-padding) + 2px)
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 2px 0 var(--spacing-track-padding)
        rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.7 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -2px 0 var(--spacing-track-padding)
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.6 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 0 0 calc(var(--spacing-track-padding) + 3px)
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.6 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.surface-button.variant-black::after.box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.05 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 0 0 calc(var(--spacing-track-padding) + 2px)
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 2px 0 var(--spacing-track-padding)
        rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.2 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -2px 0 var(--spacing-track-padding)
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 0 0 calc(var(--spacing-track-padding) + 3px)
        rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.surface-button .holo-glare.background:
conic-gradient(
      from
        calc(
          var(--pointer-angle, 0deg) + 90deg + var(--analog-light-angle-surface, 180deg) - 180deg
        )
        at 50% 50%,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 0deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 45deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 90deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 135deg,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 180deg,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 180deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 225deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 270deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 315deg,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 360deg
    )

.surface-button .holo-texture.background-image:
repeating-radial-gradient(
      circle at 50% 50%,
      transparent 0,
      transparent 2px,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 2.5px,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) 3px,
      transparent 4px
    )

.analog-switch-face.--foil:
repeating-conic-gradient(
        from calc(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 0deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 8deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22) 15deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 22deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 30deg
      ),
      repeating-radial-gradient(
        circle at 50% 50%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 0,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 1px,
        transparent 2px,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 3px,
        transparent 5px
      )

.analog-switch-lighting.variant-chrome.background:
radial-gradient(
        circle at calc(50% + sin(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg)) * 22%)
          calc(50% + cos(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg)) * -22%),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48) 18%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 36%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 52%,
        transparent 72%
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        calc(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 38%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 72%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18) 100%
      )

.analog-switch-lighting.variant-black.background:
radial-gradient(
        circle at calc(50% + sin(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg)) * 18%)
          calc(50% + cos(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg)) * -18%),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) 18%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 34%,
        transparent 64%
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        calc(var(--analog-light-angle-thumb, 180deg) - 90deg),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 36%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 74%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26) 100%
      )

.analog-switch[data-orientation='horizon.box-shadow:
12px 6px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.7 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 2px 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset -6px 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

-12px 6px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.7 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset -2px 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 6px 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.analog-switch[data-orientation='vertica.box-shadow:
0 12px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.7 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 1px 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

0 -12px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.7 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -2px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.4 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 1px 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.analog-switch[data-orientation='horizon.box-shadow:
12px 6px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.95 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 2px 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.15 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset -6px 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

-12px 6px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.95 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset -2px 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.15 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 6px 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

.analog-switch[data-orientation='vertica.box-shadow:
0 12px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.95 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.15 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 1px 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

0 -12px 15px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.95 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.15 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, calc(0.9 * var(--analog-light-power, 1))),
      inset 1px 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(0.1 * var(--analog-light-power, 1)))

items.name: utils
items.title: Utility Helpers
items.description: Shared `cn` helpers for composing class names across Analog UI registry items.

items.name: refs
items.title: Ref Utilities
items.description: Composable React ref helpers used by focusable Analog UI primitives.

items.name: angle-utils
items.title: Lighting Angle Utilities
items.description: Math helpers for blending, constraining, and advancing continuous analog light angles.

items.name: use-analog-lighting
items.title: Analog Lighting Hook
items.description: Provides the shared analog lighting context and resolved material channel styles for tactile controls.

items.name: analog-material-scope
items.title: Analog Material Scope
items.description: Provides inherited chrome and black material defaults for Analog UI control subtrees.

items.name: use-wheel-input
items.title: Wheel Input Hook
items.description: Normalizes wheel interactions for rotary and stepped Analog UI controls.

items.name: use-pointer-lighting
items.title: Pointer Lighting Hook
items.description: Tracks pointer-driven lighting changes so components can react with dynamic lighting effects.

items.name: wheel-interaction
items.title: Wheel Interaction Helpers
items.description: Shared interaction utilities for the trim-wheel style inputs and selectors.

items.name: orientation
items.title: Analog Orientation Type
items.description: Shared horizontal and vertical orientation type used by Analog UI controls.

items.name: analog-tone
items.title: Analog Tone
items.description: Shared semantic tone names for Analog UI color roles.

items.name: rocker-thumb-surface
items.title: Rocker Thumb Surface
items.description: A reusable tactile thumb shell for sliders and switches with machined analog lighting treatment.

items.name: surface-button
items.title: Surface Button
items.description: A metallic button surface with foil reflections, material variants, and pointer-responsive glare.

items.name: dial
items.title: Dial
items.description: A tactile rotary control that can behave as an endless encoder or a bounded knob with sweep, steps, and detents.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A configurable radial gauge with custom sweep geometry, caller-defined marks, semantic tone control, and optional center-fill behavior.

items.name: rotary-switch
items.title: Rotary Switch
items.description: A stepped integer rotary input with a seven-flute black selector ring, white index stripe, detent marks, and a machined Dial-style center cap.

items.name: lcd-display
items.title: LCD Display
items.description: A seven-segment readout with tone-driven lens glow, static screen texture, and shadowed vintage numerals.

items.name: needle-gauge
items.title: Needle Gauge
items.description: A mechanical readout gauge with printed scale markings, colored range zones, a glass lens, and a tone-driven physical needle.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A calibrated level meter display with optional scale presets, display ballistics, and configurable tone styling.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A tactile linear slider with caller-defined scale marks, optional audio-style legends, and shared analog lighting response.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A track switch with a 3D extruded metallic cylinder that rolls through a recessed cavity in horizontal or vertical orientations.

items.name: indicator
items.title: Indicator
items.description: A hyper-skeuomorphic status indicator with faceted glass textures, bloom, and a machined bezel.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A heavy-duty rocker switch with textured grip ridges, an anodized baseplate, and optional tone indicators.

items.name: rocker-switch-group
items.title: Rocker Switch Group
items.description: A recessed switch bank for grouping heavy-duty rocker toggles with shared material lighting and labels.

items.name: wheel-number
items.title: Wheel Number
items.description: A continuous numeric trim wheel for precise scrubbing and fine-grained analog adjustments.

items.name: wheel-select
items.title: Wheel Select
items.description: A stepped selection wheel inspired by aircraft trim controls for tactile option navigation.

items.name: square-plunger
items.title: Square Plunger
items.description: A reusable 3D square plunger surface with motion-driven physical displacement and machined lighting.

items.name: push-button
items.title: Push Button
items.description: A skeuomorphic push button with responsive text sizing, 3D extrusion, machined finish, and dynamic analog lighting.

items.name: push-toggle
items.title: Push Toggle
items.description: A latching push toggle with responsive text sizing, 3D extrusion, optional tone indicator, and state-aware analog lighting.

items.name: toggle-button-group
items.title: Toggle Button Group
items.description: A Base UI selection group for push toggles with shared recessed hardware and tone state feedback.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: An industrial rack-style panel container with optional screws and structured layout slots.
